$comment: Exact Figma layer values per variant (Sort UI 2.0, Light), exported with the export-spec.js logic. layers is a pool of unique specs; variants maps nodeId -> layer path -> pool index. radii (TL, TR, BR, BL) and sides (stroke weight T, R, B, L) are informative; the check compares r (top-left) and the stroke colour, the pixels cover the rest.
